faqAnswer1: Subscription plans are billed monthly through your Shopify account. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time. Charges appear directly on your Shopify invoice.
faqQuestion2: What happens if I exceed my plan limits?
faqAnswer2: You will receive notifications when you are approaching your limit. You can upgrade your plan at any time to increase your limits without losing data or configurations.
faqQuestion3: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqAnswer3: You can cancel your subscription from subscription management. Your plan remains active until the end of the billing period.
faqAnswer4: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately with prorated billing, while downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing cycle.
faqAnswer5: Yes. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and the app follows Shopify security requirements.
